top_signals.title: AI Selloff Spurs Haven Demand for Yen, Franc as Dollar Slips
top_signals.summary: The Japanese yen and Swiss franc outperformed their major peers as growing doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom drove demand for havens and put pressure on the US dollar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Anthropic IPO Could  Mark End of the AI Trade
top_signals.summary: Anna Wong, Bloomberg Economics Chief US Economist warns Anthropic’s slice of the token market has narrowed: and that the hyperscaler has surrendered a substantial part of its price premium without strengthening its competitive position. That’s a warning that enterprises may be moving workloads to cheaper models, weakening Anthropic’s pricing power. (Source: Bloomberg)
